routes.title: E-2 treaty-investor business plans for immigration attorneys' clients
routes.payer: E-2 investor clients referred by US immigration attorneys
routes.offer: A USCIS/consular-ready E-2 business plan: 5-year financials (monthly year 1), marginality and hiring analysis, sourced market section, unlimited revisions 30 days
routes.priceAnchor: Published E-2 plan prices $1,200 (Mikel Consulting) to $3,200 (Avvale Premium); Joorney 2023 flat fees $1,650-$4,000
routes.channel: Cold email to immigration law firms whose own sites list E-2 work (published addresses from Maps data)
routes.fulfiller: AI drafting through the Anthropic API plus a contracted E-2 plan reviewer (quote prepared, not sent; no provider has accepted)
routes.volumeBasis: unknown: the share of firms with a December E-2 filing and willing to try a new provider is unmeasured
routes.assumptions: Attorneys refer at $1,250; first-case pay-after-approval; reviewer at <= $95 a plan with re-checks included.
routes.ownerFit: No owner hours and no physical work: drafting, review, outreach and invoicing are done by Brain, the API and a contractor.

routes.fulfiller: AI drafting through the Anthropic API plus a contracted plan reviewer (not engaged)
